string-array.name: quote_text
string-array.item: Success is the sum of small efforts, repeated day in and day out.
Discipline is the bridge between goals and accomplishment.
You will never change your life until you change something you do daily.
Day by day, what you do is who you become.
Small disciplines repeated with consistency lead to great achievements gained slowly over time.
It is what we do repeatedly that matters most, not what we do occasionally.
Success is not final, failure is not fatal: it is the courage to continue that counts.
First forget inspiration. Habit is more dependable and will sustain you whether you are inspired or not.
Well done is better than well said.
Never leave till tomorrow that which you can do today.
I have not failed. I have just found ten thousand ways that will not work.
It always seems impossible until it is done.
Do the hard jobs first. The easy jobs will take care of themselves.
Do not watch the clock. Do what it does. Keep going.
Little by little, one travels far.
You do not rise to the level of your goals. You fall to the level of your systems.
Every action you take is a vote for the person you wish to become.
Motivation gets you started. Habit keeps you going.
The secret of getting ahead is getting started.
A year from now you may wish you had started today.
The best time to plant a tree was twenty years ago. The second best time is now.
Amateurs sit and wait for inspiration. The rest of us just get up and go to work.
Fall seven times, stand up eight.
Slow is smooth, and smooth is fast.
Start where you are. Use what you have. Do what you can.
When the winds of change blow, some build walls and others build windmills.
Success is walking from failure to failure with no loss of enthusiasm.
The expert in anything was once a beginner.
Great things are done by a series of small things brought together.
Rest if you must, but do not quit.
The harder you work for something, the greater you will feel when you achieve it.
Storms make trees take deeper roots.
One day or day one. You decide.
